authored_from: Articles (Serious)/technical/3B1B — Monitor - Formal Execution.md, §VIII (Partial Observability — Belief State Maintenance) + §I (Observability)
note: Sondik (1971). ★★ The observation update is EVT-10's snapshot collapse, NOT a Kalman filter — MON-2 is a declined import, and the `point_mass` half of §VIII's pseudocode is the half Sustena already has a rule for. ★ Silence widens honestly: uncertainty grows, and the mean is HELD unless a transition model was actually declared.
★★_the_no_Kalman_position_and_why_it_is_: §VIII's full-update line reads `point_mass(kalman_filter.update(observation))`. The Kalman half is deliberately not built, and this codebase already holds that position rather than adopting it here for convenience: `monitor.rs` records MON-2 as a **declined import**, quoting the article's own Additions — *'the observability and Kalman apparatus of §I–II assumes a continuous linear system ẋ = Ax + Bu. Sustena's state is discrete, typed, and event-sourced [...] a loose import, not a literal fit.'* ★★ What survives is the `point_mass`, and Sustena already knows what an observation of an external authority means: §VII's snapshot dimension, where **a newer reading supersedes**. So `Belief` holds an EVT-10 `SnapshotDim` and collapses **through** it — the coherence is structural rather than parallel, and *'an observation arrived'* has one meaning in this codebase instead of two.

divergence.statement: `belief`, `pomdp`, `uncertainty` and `sensor_silent` are grep-0 in apps/api/sustena/. Nothing there maintains an estimate of a quantity it has stopped hearing about — a dimension simply keeps its last written value, with nothing recording that the value is getting older.
divergence.★_the_counterweight_a_COARSE_staleness_n: Exact, and it is more than a token. `ingest_engine.get_sources()` computes `is_stale` per source against a **declared** `expected_interval_minutes` — and it is careful in the way that matters: a source with **no declared cadence is never flagged**, because guessing one would fabricate a fact. `devui.py` surfaces stale sources on the Monitor's needs-attention block, so *this source went quiet* is already a real, visible, honestly-scoped signal there. What it does not do is say anything about the **value**: staleness is binary and per-source, where a belief is continuous and per-dimension.
divergence.★_and_the_escalation_path_it_would_ride_: The Monitor→Controller boundary is `detect::Severity::escalates()` here and the needs-attention → Controller surface there. So neither side is missing the road; what is new is the cargo — an estimate that degrades, and a threshold crossing that reports *we have lost sight of this* rather than *this source is quiet*.
divergence.★★_the_shape_of_the_gap_stated_precisely: Three things, and only the third is conceptually new. (1) **Per-dimension rather than per-source** — a source can be alive while the quantity it reports is stale, and vice versa. (2) **Continuous rather than binary** — `is_stale` is true or false; a variance says *how much* has been lost, which is what a band on a chart needs. (3) ★★ **The estimate degrades rather than the flag flipping** — the reference's last written value stays exactly as authoritative-looking at hour 48 as at minute 1, and that is the specific dishonesty a belief state removes.

term_by_term.★ a per-source staleness flag: AT PARITY, and correctly scoped there — never flagged without a declared cadence.
term_by_term.★★ a belief with a MEAN and a growing VA: RUST-AHEAD. `variance` has 4 hits there and every one is `variance_kg` in procurement — a delivery shortfall, not an uncertainty.
term_by_term.★★ widening under silence: RUST-AHEAD, and this is the row: nothing anywhere records that an unobserved value is getting less reliable.
term_by_term.the observation collapsing to a point ma: RUST-AHEAD as a belief operation — but AT PARITY as a *rule*, since the LWW-supersede it reuses is the guard the reference derived empirically (EVT-10's counterweight, and the same one applies here).
term_by_term.★ SENSOR_SILENT as an admission rather t: RUST-AHEAD in the framing as much as the code. `is_stale` reads as a fault; §VIII's alert is explicitly *not* a claim that anything is wrong.
term_by_term.Kalman: ★ NEITHER SIDE HAS IT, AND NEITHER SHOULD. `kalman` is grep-0 there and declined here. Recorded so a future reader does not read the absence as a gap on either side.

the_greppable_false_positives_named_so_n.variance (4 hits, all procurement): ★ `variance_kg` in `operators/procurement.py` — the difference between an expected and an actual delivery quantity. A real, useful number and the exact opposite kind of thing: a measured discrepancy, not an uncertainty about an unmeasured value.
the_greppable_false_positives_named_so_n.last_seen (9 hits, and genuinely adjacen: `ingest_sources.last_seen_at`, which is the counterweight above. Named so it is read as the partial parity it is rather than as a coincidence.

divergence.what_python_does_have_and_why_it_is_not_: An honestly-scoped per-source staleness flag that never guesses a cadence, surfaced on the right panel, riding a real escalation path. What it does not have is any statement about the VALUE — so a reading from two days ago is displayed with exactly the confidence of one from a minute ago.
divergence.the_honest_limits: Six. (1) ★★ NOT A JOINT POMDP BELIEF — a distribution over the whole state space is intractable for a rich state, and §VIII's own render only asks for `mean()` and `variance()`; this builds the tractable form (per observed dimension, mean + growing variance) and names the joint belief as the model it approximates. (2) ★★ THE POINT-MASS COLLAPSE ASSUMES THE OBSERVATION IS AUTHORITATIVE — variance goes to **zero** at a reading, because §VII's snapshot dimension treats the reading of an external authority *as* the value. **For a genuinely noisy sensor that is a modelling assumption this makes and does not check** — and modelling measurement noise is exactly where a Kalman filter would come in, which is the declined import. The two are the same decision seen twice, and the cost is stated rather than hidden. (3) ★ NO TRANSITION MODEL IS INVENTED — `Dynamics::Unknown` holds the mean and grows only the uncertainty; a drift moves it only where one was declared. (4) THE DRIFT RATE IS DECLARED, NOT LEARNED — nothing estimates it from history, which would be a real further row. (5) ★ §I's OBSERVABILITY MATRIX IS NOT BUILT — `ungoverned()` answers only the case that needs no matrix (a governed dimension no sensor has ever spoken about); rank analysis is MON-1 and is a slot. (6) NOT WIRED INTO `MonitorEngine` — the tracker is per-sustain state designed to sit alongside the CUSUM/EWMA chain, and the wiring is named rather than claimed.
divergence.when_python_catches_up: These cases become parity vectors unchanged. The step is smaller than it looks, because the declared cadence `is_stale` already reads is exactly the input a drift rate needs.
divergence.not_a_divergence_in: R1 behaviour. Purely additive: a new module, no call site in `execute` or `MonitorEngine`, and the only change to existing code is a serde derive on `Severity` so an alert is persistable.

fixture.why: §VIII's own example — a soil sensor that goes quiet — with its own `silence_threshold_hours: 6`, plus a second dimension that keeps reporting, so *only what actually went quiet* raises anything.

stale_reading.note: ★ arrives AFTER a newer one and must not collapse the belief

observation_cases.name: ★_an_observation_collapses_the_belief_to_a_POINT_MASS
observation_cases.why: ★ §VIII's `point_mass`, with the Kalman half deliberately absent. At the instant of a reading the variance is **zero**, because §VII treats the reading of an external authority as the value — which is a real modelling assumption, stated in the limits rather than buried.

observation_cases.name: ★★_a_STALE_observation_arriving_LATE_does_NOT_collapse_the_belief
observation_cases.why: ★★ THE COHERENCE PROOF, and the reason this is not a second notion of *an observation arrived*. `Belief` holds an EVT-10 `SnapshotDim` and the supersede runs **through it**, so a reading that loses on `(τ, id)` loses here exactly as it would on the state dimension. The belief is unchanged and says so — `Collapse::Stale`, naming what it kept and when. A belief that took whatever arrived last would disagree with the state it is a belief *about*.

observation_cases.name: ★_an_EQUAL_event_time_breaks_on_the_id_as_it_does_on_the_state_dimension
observation_cases.why: ★ The same total order, reused rather than re-derived — checked in both directions so it is the order deciding and not the arrival sequence.

observation_cases.name: hearing_again_collapses_the_variance_back_to_zero
observation_cases.why: The other half of the loop: uncertainty that has grown over three hours of silence goes back to a point the moment the sensor speaks. Without this the band would only ever widen, which would make it decoration rather than a reading.

silence_cases.name: ★★_uncertainty_grows_MONOTONICALLY_with_silence
silence_cases.why: ★★ §VIII's `widen(belief, sigma = elapsed * DRIFT_RATE)`, taken literally — `σ = elapsed_hours × drift_rate`, `variance = σ²`. Checked across 24 consecutive hours rather than at one convenient point, because *the longer unheard, the less known* is a property of the whole curve and a formula that dipped anywhere would be worse than one that was simply wrong.

silence_cases.name: ★★_with_NO_transition_model_the_mean_is_HELD_and_only_uncertainty_grows
silence_cases.why: ★★ The honest floor, and the discipline this row could most easily have broken. §VIII's `predict_forward(belief, transition_model)` is only honest if a transition model exists; inventing one to fill the pseudocode's shape would put a **made-up trajectory behind a real-looking mean**, which is worse than admitting ignorance. `Dynamics::Unknown` holds the value and grows the band: *we know less*, not *we know something else*. And the type implements no `Default`, so the choice is declared.

silence_cases.name: ★_a_DECLARED_drift_moves_the_mean_and_nothing_else_does
silence_cases.why: ★ The other side of the same discipline: where someone has genuinely said how a quantity behaves while unobserved, `predict_forward` is real and the mean moves. The difference between the two cases is a declaration, not a heuristic.

escalation_cases.name: ★_silence_past_the_threshold_alerts_and_before_it_does_not
escalation_cases.why: ★ §VIII's `elapsed > silence_threshold_hours`, at the article's own six hours. Checked on both sides of the line, because a threshold that fires early is a false alarm and one that never fires is decoration.

escalation_cases.name: ★★_the_alert_rides_the_EXISTING_Monitor_to_Controller_boundary
escalation_cases.why: ★★ `detect::Severity::escalates()` is the one function that already draws that line, so the silence alert reuses it rather than inventing a second notion of crossing. ★ But it is deliberately **not** a `detect::Alert`: that type carries a `Shift`, and **nothing shifted** — claiming a direction the data does not have would be a worse error than a second struct. The boundary is reused; the shape is not.

expect.describe_contains: NOT because something is known to be wrong

escalation_cases.name: ★★_a_silence_alert_can_NEVER_be_INFO
escalation_cases.why: ★★ §VIII defines the escalation as happening *'because uncertainty has grown to the point where human attention is warranted'* — so an alert that stays in the Monitor is not this alert. The severity is declared, and the one value that would contradict the section is **refused at declaration** rather than allowed and hoped about.

escalation_cases.name: hearing_again_CLEARS_the_alert
escalation_cases.why: The admission is retracted when it stops being true: the sensor spoke, so we can see it again. An alert that persisted after contact resumed would train a person to ignore it.

escalation_cases.name: only_what_ACTUALLY_went_quiet_raises_anything
escalation_cases.why: Two dimensions, one still reporting: exactly one alert. Per-dimension tracking is the point — a source can be alive while one quantity it reports has gone stale, and the reverse.

observability_cases.name: ★_a_GOVERNED_dimension_never_observed_is_reported_UNGOVERNED
observability_cases.why: ★ §I's decisive implication — *'every state variable worth governing must be reachable from a measurable output; unmeasured state is ungoverned state.'* This answers the concrete half that needs no matrix: a quantity someone declared worth governing that **no sensor has ever spoken about**. Full observability-matrix rank analysis is MON-1 and is named as a slot rather than approximated, because a rough answer to a rank question is worse than none.
